_read_me: The course of the River Vistula through the map, from north-west to south-east, as [longitude, latitude] pairs. Traced through the positions of the Warsaw bridges (Maria Sklodowska-Curie, Grot-Rowecki, Gdanski, Slasko-Dabrowski, Swietokrzyski, Poniatowski, Lazienkowski, Siekierkowski), so it is accurate to a few hundred metres. To refine it, replace the list with points from a survey map in the same order. The map draws it under everything else and labels it.
name: Vistula
